errors.evidence: The categories on the horizontal axis are "Exportperformance Deutschlands", "Deutsche Exportzielmärkte", and "Deutsche Exporte". The description incorrectly lists one of the categories and confuses the other two with the legend labels for the time periods.

errors.text_span: Die vertikale Achse ist mit „Exportperformance Deutschlands“ beschriftet
errors.evidence: The vertical axis is not labeled in the chart. "Exportperformance Deutschlands" is the first category on the horizontal axis.

errors.text_span: und reicht von -1,3 bis 4,5 in linearen Schritten von 0,1.
errors.evidence: The chart does not display any tick marks or scale values on the y-axis. Stating that the scale has steps of 0.1 is a hallucination.

errors.text_span: Drei gestapelte Balken stehen für jede Kategorie.
errors.evidence: The chart shows two grouped bars for each category, not three stacked bars.

errors.text_span: Der Balken „2000–2015“ ist blau dargestellt und hat einen Wert von 2,8.
errors.evidence: This statement is confusing and incorrect. The value 2.8 corresponds to the magenta bar (period 2015-2024) for the category "Deutsche Exportzielmärkte". None of the blue bars have a value of 2.8.

errors.text_span: der magenta gefärbte Balken einen Wert von 4,5.
errors.evidence: For the category "Deutsche Exportzielmärkte", the magenta bar has a value of 2.8, not 4.5. The value 4.5 corresponds to the blue bar in the "Deutsche Exporte" category.

The description is highly incomplete. It fails to list all data points and categories correctly. It completely omits the values for "Exportperformance Deutschlands" (0.1, -1.3) and "Deutsche Exporte" (4.5, 1.5), including the only negative value in the chart.
